source:
@@U04014@@
past any hillock. Rage all it likes,
a modest height can proudly hold its own,
but a slight drop will powerfully draw it downward.
Knowing this,
plan upon plan invaded my mind.
I would bar the lordly ocean from our shore,
set limits to its domain,
and push it ever backward upon itself.
Ah, what satisfaction that would bring me!
I worked it out step by step.
This is my wish.
Dare now to help me achieve it!
(Distant drums and martial music are heard from the rear, to the right of
the audience.)

@@U04016@@
No problem.
Do you hear those distant drums?

@@U04018@@
Another war!
No man in his right senses
would welcome it!

@@U04020@@
Oh, war or peace, what’s the difference!
What's sensible is working it to your advantage.
You keep a sharp eye peeled,
take note of every favorable opportunity.
All right, then, the opportunity is
in your favor now, 浮士德!
Seize it!

@@U04022@@
Enough of your nonsense!
Say it straight out for once!
What do you mean?
translation:
@@U04014@@
越过任何一座小山丘。随心所欲地发怒，
适度的身高可以自豪地保持自己的地位，
但轻微的下降就会有力地将其向下拉。
知道这一点后，
一个又一个的计划侵入了我的脑海。
我会把雄伟的海洋从我们的海岸上拒之门外，
对其域设置限制，
并将其不断向后推向自身。
啊，这会给我带来多么大的满足啊！
我是一步步搞出来的。
这是我的愿望。
现在敢于帮助我实现它！
（后方右侧传来远处的鼓声和军乐声
观众。）

@@U04016@@
没问题。
你听到远处的鼓声了吗？

@@U04018@@
又一场战争！
没有一个理智正常的人
会欢迎的！

@@U04020@@
哦，战争还是和平，有什么区别！
明智的做法是让它对你有利。
你保持敏锐的目光，
留意每一个有利的机会。
好吧，那么机会来了
现在对你有利了，浮士德！
抓住它！

@@U04022@@
你的废话够了！
直接说一次吧！
你是什​​么意思？
